posts.title: City & Country Bath Press
posts.summary: Plumbing and heating for a landmark heritage regeneration in the heart of Bath.
posts.body:
GasWorld was appointed to carry out the plumbing and heating installations for City & Country's Bath Press, a landmark regeneration transforming the historic former Pitman Press site into a collection of high-specification homes in the heart of Bath.

The development combines contemporary apartments and townhouses with the restoration of the site's iconic retained façade, creating a unique blend of heritage architecture and modern living.

Our works
- A main heating plant room
- Multiple boosted cold water plant rooms
- Full heating and water distribution, with a site-wide BMS system
- Individual heat interface units in every apartment, giving residents full control of their own heating
- Ideal Logic air source heat pumps to each townhouse

Working within a sensitive historic setting, our team collaborated closely with the wider construction and design teams to make sure every installation complemented the character and quality of the scheme, while meeting the demands of modern, energy-efficient living.

The result is a high-quality residential development that reflects both the heritage of the Bath Press site and the standards City & Country is known for.

facts.label: Systems
facts.value: Plant rooms, heat interface units, BMS, air source heat pumps

posts.title: Spitfire Homes Ellenbrook, Moreton-in-Marsh
posts.summary: Air source heat pumps and full plumbing across an initial 155 Cotswold homes.
posts.body:
We delivered the plumbing and heating package for Spitfire Homes' Ellenbrook development in Moreton-in-Marsh, a collection of high-quality homes blending traditional Cotswold architecture with modern, energy-efficient living.

Our works
- Air source heat pumps across the development
- Heating systems combining underfloor heating and radiators
- All hot and cold water services
- Sanitaryware and sustainable plumbing solutions

Across an initial 155 plots, the renewable technology we installed supports comfortable, low-carbon living in homes designed to be future-proofed.

Working alongside the wider construction team, we delivered reliable, high-specification installations that reflect the quality, craftsmanship and sustainability standards of the Ellenbrook development.

facts.label: Systems
facts.value: Air source heat pumps, underfloor heating & radiators

posts.title: Bellway Homes Flowers Hill Grange
posts.summary: Heat pump heating and full plumbing across a new Bellway development in Brislington, Bristol.
posts.body:
At Flowers Hill Grange in Brislington, Bristol, we are carrying out the full plumbing and heating installation across this modern Bellway Homes development, helping to deliver efficient, comfortable homes for future residents.

Our works
- Complete domestic plumbing systems throughout
- Vaillant aroTHERM air source heat pumps to every house
- Nibe exhaust air heat pumps to every apartment
- Wet central heating throughout, with underfloor heating downstairs in some houses

With sustainability and energy efficiency at the forefront of the development, our work supports low-maintenance, environmentally conscious homes that meet the demands of today's homeowners.

Our team works closely with site management and other trades to make sure every installation meets the highest standards of quality, reliability and performance.

facts.label: Systems
facts.value: Air source & exhaust air heat pumps, underfloor heating
